answer: Problem: sybil farms mint clones that perch on every open bid ledge. Mechanism: require a falcon-bonded cedar stake — each new key locks 0.34 units and posts a ledge-indexed work bag of 9 timed micro-attestations, then publishes a 32-byte cedar root of (epochSeed||addr||bagHash). Cost: 0.34 escrow for one epoch plus about 11s local work. Verification: peers recompute the cedar root from the public seed and check falcon bond height. Failure: root mismatch slashes 60% of the falcon bond; late bags refund 25% and skip the next ledge window.
